trends.name: Iran War Energy Crisis Escalates
trends.summary: US energy inflation surged +10.9% in March, the largest monthly jump since 2005, driven by Iran conflict disruptions. Strait of Hormuz operating at only 10% capacity with potential jet fuel crunch within 3 weeks, forcing airlines to consider flight cancellations. White House claims Hormuz can reopen within 2 months, but commodity disruptions expected to last months to years.

trends.name: US-Iran Ceasefire Negotiations Uncertainty
trends.summary: Critical weekend US-Iran peace talks in Pakistan with major market implications. Iran threatened to withdraw from negotiations to halt Israeli attacks on Beirut, signaling fragile ceasefire prospects. Skepticism remains high with officials cautioning against expecting positive outcomes, creating volatility for risk assets and energy markets.

trends.name: Inflation Persists Despite Cooling Signals
trends.summary: March CPI at +3.3% y/y with energy-led spike complicating Fed outlook. Core inflation cooler at +2.6%, but wage growth at +3.5% barely exceeds inflation, creating household purchasing power squeeze. Energy component jumped +10.9%, overshadowing overall moderation and extending inflation uncertainty into 2026.

trends.name: Q1 2026 Earnings Season Kicks Off
trends.summary: Major banks report earnings Tuesday with 1,100+ companies reporting week of April 20th and 2,500+ in following week. Key names include $AAPL, $MSFT, $AMZN, $GOOGL, $TSM, $LLY, $TSLA, $CVX. Results will reveal corporate resilience amid inflation, geopolitical disruptions, and shifting consumer sentiment.

trends.name: Consumer Sentiment Hits Record Lows
trends.summary: Consumer sentiment reached record low levels driven by Iran war economic fears and inflation concerns. Americans increasingly blame geopolitical conflict for economic deterioration. This metric signals potential demand weakness heading into earnings season and threatens consumer discretionary stocks.

trends.name: Big Tech Stock Valuations Reassessed
trends.summary: Mixed signals on major tech: some strategists see opportunity with valuations attractive amid market slowdown, while software sector experiencing dramatic selloff (Palo Alto Networks leading decline). Apple's new MacBook Neo targets affordable segment, but unionized store closures signal labor pressure. Tech earnings next week will be critical inflection point.

trends.name: Stagflation Dynamics Resurface
trends.summary: GDP growth slowing while inflation remains sticky creates classic stagflation conditions that challenge traditional 60-40 portfolio allocation. Markets haven't fully repriced risk despite macro deterioration. Energy disruptions from Iran war threaten to extend inflationary pressures while growth momentum wanes, creating unfavorable risk-reward for bonds and stocks.

trends.name: Anthropic's Mythos AI Cyber Threat
trends.summary: Powell and Treasury Secretary Bessent discussed Anthropic's Mythos AI cyber threat with major US banks, signaling serious systemic risk concerns. Massive market implications for financial system stability and cybersecurity spending. This emerging threat could reshape AI investment thesis and banking sector risk premiums.

trends.name: Private Credit Market Deterioration
trends.summary: Private credit markets becoming increasingly problematic amid macro uncertainties and higher cost of capital. This trend has implications for corporate refinancing costs, credit quality degradation, and potential financial stability risks given the size of the private credit universe.

trends.name: International Equities Rally Vs US Weakness
trends.summary: $VEU international stocks posted nearly their best 2-week rally since 2020 (+9.0%), signaling potential diversification away from concentrated US tech exposure. Reflects rotation toward value and geographically diversified portfolios as US inflation pressures persist and growth slows.

trends.name: Insurance Industry Faces Systemic Risk
trends.summary: Ratings firm warned insurance industry may not survive next financial crisis intact, contrasting with 2008-09 resilience. With rising inflation, climate disasters from geopolitical disruptions, and potential macroeconomic stress, insurance sector valuations and risk profiles require reassessment.

trends.name: Trump Administration Trade & Iran Policy
trends.summary: Trump administration claiming stability in trade negotiations with planned Xi Jinping visit, attempting to manage markets while Iran conflict creates commodity disruptions. Mixed signals: administration confident on Hormuz reopening timeline while tensions remain, creating policy uncertainty for investors.
